name: Advisor Profile + Book Architecture
description: Restructure the /advisor-intelligence page so Tab 3 is role-conditional (admin: Books firm landing; non-admin: direct render of own AdvisorPublicProfile from JWT advisorId). Profile/Book becomes a local in-component toggle inside AdvisorPublicProfile (not a cross-tab nav) that swaps between the existing profile view and a new AdvisorBookView (single advisor book fetch, independent cache key). Fee/role breakdown removed from BooksTab L2 admin drill and becomes Profile-only (window-aware, per-fee-bucket from D_00c Option 1 already shipped in d3abb883). AdvisorsTab leaderboard made inert for non-admins by passing undefined drill handler. Single choke-point defense in depth: non-admin can only reach their own profile, enforced cosmetically on frontend and authoritatively via Lambda@Edge scoping on /api/scoped/partners/books/advisor/{advisorId}/* endpoints.
